title: New topic tab
description: Hermes searches YouTube, curates with AI and shows a preview. Nothing is saved until you say so.

field.label: What do you want a tab about?
field.placeholder: e.g. AI agents, sourdough bread, Roman history
field.hint: A few words are enough. Hermes plans the searches.
field.invalid: Hermes couldn't use this text. Try other words.

progress.lead: This usually takes 1–3 minutes: Hermes is reading the candidates one by one.
progress.background: Closing this window doesn't stop it: the tab keeps building and Subscriptions tells you when it's ready.
progress.coming_desc: The videos Hermes keeps show up here.
progress.cancel_failed: Couldn't cancel; the search will finish on its own. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

preview.videos_desc: Drop what doesn't fit with 👎 (or D on a focused video). Hermes learns from it.
preview.seeds_desc: Channels with 3 or more kept videos. Following them keeps this tab fresh.
preview.seeds_empty: No channel showed up 3 or more times, so the tab will rely on search.
preview.partial: Time ran out before Hermes rated everything. You can save what is here or try again.
preview.saved_title: This topic is already a tab
preview.saved: Open it in Subscriptions, or start a new topic.
preview.all_removed: Bring them back, or rephrase the topic.

empty.title: Nothing found for “{query}”
empty.desc: Try fewer or broader words, or a related topic.

ai.no_model_desc: Topic tabs need an AI model to plan the searches and curate. Pick one and sign in under Settings → Models first.
ai.provider_unavailable_title: Hermes couldn't reach your AI model

no_model.title: Pick an AI model first
no_model.desc: Topic tabs need a model to plan the searches and curate. Pick one and sign in under Settings → Models.

provider_unavailable.title: Hermes couldn't reach your AI model

busy.title: A topic tab is already being built
busy.desc: Hermes builds one topic tab at a time. Follow it, or try again when it finishes.

error.title: Couldn't build the preview
error.expired: Previews are kept for 7 days. Start a new one.
error.conflict: This topic was already saved as a tab.
